facts.claim: The Resource Groups Tagging API reference says that the GetResources operation supports all resource types, and names two exceptions: GetResources does not support IAM users and roles, and it returns an empty response for EC2 Auto Scaling groups. GetResources returns the tagged or previously tagged resources in the specified Region for the account. Amazon EFS lets you create tags for EFS file systems and access points, and AWS Resource Groups lists AWS::EFS::FileSystem as a resource type for tag-based groups. EFS file systems are not among the named exceptions.

First time using the AWS CLI? See the User Guide for help getting started.
[ aws . efs ]
# tag-resource¶
## Description¶
Creates a tag for an EFS resource. You can create tags for EFS file systems and access points using this API operation.
This operation requires permissions for the elasticfilesystem:TagResource action.
See also: AWS API Documentation
## Synopsis¶
  tag-resource
--resource-id <value>
